decisions.rationale: The placement test written in round 2 read the last mechanism sentence, so a report that interleaved theory with the reproduction passed while breaking the rule. Anchored on the first mechanism sentence, with what it forbids spelled out. The same filing's second half, the research-material claim, is accepted only where it names the skill's own production history and rejected again elsewhere on the mechanism two plan reviews have already checked
decisions.evidence: agent-packages/problem-report-authoring/.apm/skills/problem-report-authoring/SKILL.md:77-84 anchors on the first mechanism sentence, defines new as 'did not already appear above it', permits a back-reference to a run already pasted, and keeps the hedge clause; SKILL.md:258-259 carries the same wording. Symbol or owner: the test asks what a sentence asserts, not which section encloses it, so an analysis paragraph inside a narrative field is caught. Fixture bigger than the defect: the interleaved draft fails, the exemplar with one trailing section passes, and a report with no analysis passes vacuously. What the test cannot see: whether the theory is correct. The production-history clause is replaced by a named public artifact, gradle/gradle#39079, one report rather than a corpus
